product: MR conventional magnet line (1.5 tesla and 3 tesla scanners built around a helium-cooled superconducting magnet)
tolerance_line: An install more than 30 days late, or a line stop longer than 30 days, goes past the 30-day limit.
confidence_basis: All 11 panel members agreed on both questions and on which site or supplier fails in each future. The dates after 2028 are votes on undated events, and the numbers that decide whether a failure is real (days of helium on hand, weeks of logic stock and the cold-head parent's share of revenue) are Placeholders that no owner has confirmed. Every internal value in this run is synthetic.
